original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH item_filter AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
store_sales_2001 AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
         ss.ss_customer_sk,
         ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
         ss.ss_quantity,
         d1.d_date AS d1_date
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
   AND d1.d_year = 2001
  JOIN item_filter i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_marital_status,
       cd.cd_education_status,
       hd.hd_vehicle_count,
       count(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales_2001 ss
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
 AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
 AND d2.d_date BETWEEN ss.d1_date AND ss.d1_date + INTERVAL '30 days'
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
 AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_state = w.w_state
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
      AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           cd.cd_gender,
           cd.cd_marital_status,
           cd.cd_education_status,
           hd.hd_vehicle_count
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
),
prefiltered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity,
           d1.d_date AS ss_date,
           fc.cd_gender,
           fc.cd_marital_status,
           fc.cd_education_status,
           fc.hd_vehicle_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_customers fc
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year = 2001
),
prefiltered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
           d2.d_date AS ws_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_customers fc
      ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
)
SELECT ss.cd_gender,
       ss.cd_marital_status,
       ss.cd_education_status,
       ss.hd_vehicle_count,
       count(*) AS cnt
FROM prefiltered_store_sales ss
JOIN prefiltered_web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
 AND ws.ws_date BETWEEN ss.ss_date AND (ss.ss_date + interval '30' day)
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_state = w.w_state
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
 AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
GROUP BY ss.cd_gender,
         ss.cd_marital_status,
         ss.cd_education_status,
         ss.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON sr_store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
      AND s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')

),
store_avg_return AS (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_store_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)

FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_avg_return sar ON sar.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_store_return * 1.2
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'

        sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,

        AND SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) FILTER (WHERE tw.year_flag = 'last')
            > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)

        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ret_ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        wr.wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ret_ca
      ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ret_ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78
      AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 28 AND 57
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ret_ca.ca_state, wr.wr_reason_sk
),
state_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) AS ctr_state_avg
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN state_avg sa
  ON sa.ctr_state = ctr1.ctr_state
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address curr_ca
  ON curr_ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.ctr_state_avg * 1.2
  AND curr_ca.ca_state IN ('IA', 'MT', 'NE', 'TX')
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk IN (3, 31)
  AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944

    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,

WITH cs_ui AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        s.s_zip AS store_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
        ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
        ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
        ss_f.syear,
        d2.d_year AS fsyear,
        d3.d_year AS s2year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(ss_f.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
        SUM(ss_f.ss_list_price) AS s2,
        SUM(ss_f.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ss.ss_store_sk,
            ss.ss_customer_sk,
            ss.ss_cdemo_sk,
            ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
            ss.ss_addr_sk,
            ss.ss_item_sk,
            ss.ss_promo_sk,
            ss.ss_wholesale_cost,
            ss.ss_list_price,
            ss.ss_coupon_amt,
            d1.d_year AS syear
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim d1
          ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
         AND d1.d_year IN (1999, 2000)
        JOIN cs_ui
          ON cs_ui.cs_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        JOIN store_returns sr
          ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
         AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    ) ss_f
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ss_f.ss_store_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ss_f.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = ss_f.ss_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('W','D')
     AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('College','4 yr Degree')
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
      ON hd1.hd_demo_sk = ss_f.ss_hdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1
      ON ad1.ca_address_sk = ss_f.ss_addr_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ss_f.ss_item_sk
     AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('W','D')
     AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College','4 yr Degree')
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
      ON hd2.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2
      ON ad2.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
     AND ad2.ca_state IN ('GA','IL','OH')
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = c.c_first_sales_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = c.c_first_shipto_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = ss_f.ss_promo_sk
     AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
     AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
     AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    JOIN income_band ib1
      ON ib1.ib_income_band_sk = hd1.hd_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2
      ON ib2.ib_income_band_sk = hd2.hd_income_band_sk
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    GROUP BY
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_item_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city,
        ad1.ca_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city,
        ad2.ca_zip,
        ss_f.syear,
        d2.d_year,
        d3.d_year
)
SELECT
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs1.store_zip,
    cs1.b_street_number,
    cs1.b_street_name,
    cs1.b_city,
    cs1.b_zip,
    cs1.c_street_number,
    cs1.c_street_name,
    cs1.c_city,
    cs1.c_zip,
    cs1.syear,
    cs1.cnt,
    cs1.s1 AS s11,
    cs1.s2 AS s21,
    cs1.s3 AS s31,
    cs2.s1 AS s12,
    cs2.s2 AS s22,
    cs2.s3 AS s32,
    cs2.syear,
    cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2
  ON cs2.item_sk = cs1.item_sk
 AND cs2.store_name = cs1.store_name
 AND cs2.store_zip = cs1.store_zip
 AND cs2.syear = 2000
 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
WHERE cs1.syear = 1999
ORDER BY
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs2.cnt,
    cs1.s1,
    cs2.s1;
